title: Coyote — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Coyote.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Outdoor Innovation." Specialty tier. Coyote Outdoor Living makes premium outdoor grills and components with innovative features like their C-Series infinity burners. Growing brand in the outdoor kitchen segment with good value at the premium level.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Premium outdoor builds wanting innovation. Cross-shop with Blaze and Fire Magic.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Coyote:

• Infinity burners for consistent heat

• Innovative features at premium pricing

• Growing reputation in outdoor cooking

• Good value vs Lynx and Twin Eagles

• Strong stainless construction
